[[File:Lottery_numbers.gif|thumb|The winning lottery numbers featured in the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] channel.]]
Before the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this '''game of chance''' had its results featured in the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] channel. The player would choose a series of numbers, then a drawing would occur. If the chosen numbers were also the ones drawn, the player would win a prize&mdash;most probably [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic Dactaries]].
